Sara: Quick heads-up — AcmeCorp POC kick-off. They want a 2-week scoped POC to validate invoice-extraction + guided QA assistant. We need: prompt inventory, baseline prompts for each flow, success criteria, and a short pricing estimate for Dedicated vs Hosted. Can SEs + AE align?
Mike: On it. Clarify scope: 1) extraction (structured fields from invoice PDFs) 2) QA assistant (contextual answers + citations). Do we need reranking/embeddings for retrieval? Also, what latency SLO do they expect?
Anita: Yes to embeddings for retrieval layer on the QA side. For extraction we'll use a fine-tuned/adapter model + regex post-processing. Latency target asked by Legal was ~300ms p95 for interactive demo, but AE prefers <200ms. We should propose two tiers.
Ben: POC success metrics suggestion:
- Extraction: >95% field-level F1 on 50 holdout invoices
- QA assistant: >85% helpfulness (human eval on 100 queries), and <=5% hallucination flagged in evals
- Infra: demo latency p95 <300ms (hosted) or <200ms (dedicated)
- Cost: baseline estimate (hosted) < $1k for 2 weeks, dedicated reserve quote TBD
Priya: Security Qs from AcmeSec: data residency, KMS keys, retention policy, and SOC2 evidence. They also asked for a short answer in questionnaire about model privacy and fallback handling.
Sara: Good — I'll attach questionnaire link to customer. Also need a one-liner for sales about what counts as "passed" for this POC.
Anita: Draft pass criteria we can use:
- Extraction pipeline achieves >=95% F1 on the shared test set (same sample they provided)
- QA assistant passes 85% binning of "accurate + useful" in blind eval
- No high-severity security blockers in the questionnaire and signed TOU on limited data retention
- Demo flows run under latency SLO and basic load (10 concurrent users)
Mike: Prompt inventory (rough first pass):
- extraction/parse_pdf_v1: prompt that extracts fields as JSON from OCR text
- extraction/normalize_amount: prompt to normalize currency, decimals
- qa/retrieval_prompt_v1: system+instruction for contextual answer with citation
- qa/fallback_safe: safety-first prompt to avoid hallucination
Example prompts:
```
# extraction/parse_pdf_v1
Instruction: "You are a structured extractor. Given OCR text, return JSON with keys: invoice_id, date, total, vendor_name, line_items[]."
```
```
# qa/retrieval_prompt_v1
System: "You are an assistant that answers using the provided context. Always cite the paragraph id. If uncertain, say \"I don't know\" and request docs."
```
Anita: We'll set up a small eval harness: automated unit tests + human annotation sheet. For unit tests, use 50 labeled invoices from Acme + 20 adversarial cases (bad OCR, multiple currencies).
Joel: Timeline proposal:
- Day 0: Kickoff + sec questionnaire sent
- Day 1-3: Prompt baseline + infra config (hosted demo) — provide initial hosted token and repo
- Day 4-8: Run extraction baseline + quick eval
- Day 9-11: Retrieval/QA integration + eval
- Day 12-13: Buffer + final demo prep
- Day 14: Demo + handoff
Sara: Sounds tight but doable. Who owns the eval sheet and final pass/fail report?
Ben: I'll own the eval sheet and coordinate annotators. Anita — can you check-in on Day 5 with interim results and a quick triage doc? Ping me when ready.
Anita: Yep. I'll drop a short interim report and a minimal artifacts list (prompt versions, model ids, eval CSV). Expect it by EOD Day 5.
Priya: Note on pricing: quick hosted estimate for 2-week POC (all dev + demo traffic) ~ $800-$1,200 if we stay on small model variants and batching. Dedicated will need a sizing call — likely $5k/month min for committed pool; mention that to customer as a ballpark.
Sara: I'll frame that as "hosted POC estimate ~$1k; dedicated engagement requires sizing and contract". Also adding legal redline: retention 30 days max, logs accessible for debug, KMS per their request.
Mike: For the prompt baseline, I'll commit to the following deliverables in the repo:
- prompts/ (v1 text files)
- eval/ (unit tests + manual annotation CSV template)
- infra/ (runbook for demo, sample docker-compose for hosted mock)
Link to skeleton: https://docs.google.com/some-skeleton
Anita: Small technical note: recommend enabling prefix KV caching for the QA retrieval flow to reduce token spend during demos. We'll include a config suggestion in infra/runbook.
deploy-bot: [info] Reserved demo capacity scheduled for 2024-05-22 10:00Z on hosted pool 'sandbox-demo-1'.
Sara: Thanks all — next actions: Sara to send sec questionnaire + timeline to customer; Anita builds prompt baseline and interim report; Ben prepares eval sheet; Mike pushes skeleton repo and infra runbook; Priya prepares pricing blurb. We'll sync Day 3 for status. :thumbsup:
Mike: minor checklist item — confirm sample invoices format (PDFs vs PNGs). Sara — can you upload sample bundle to the drive?
Sara: Uploading now: https://drive.google.com/acme-samples (shared with the team)
Ben: Got it. I'll start annotations when Anita flags day 5 output. :white_check_mark:
Joel: I'll schedule the Day 3 sync invite for Friday 09:00 PT.
Sara: Perfect — closing thread, will post updates in this thread.
